Policy: Attendance and Leave Policy (Version V.02, effective 2025-01-01)
Policy ID: attendance-leave-policy
Section: 3 Attendance > 3.2 Flexi hours
Topic: 3.2.1 9:00:00 AM - 9:30:00 AM are considered as Flexi hours for employees working at corporate office, Mumbai Office.
3.2.1. 9:00:00 AM - 9:30:00 AM are considered as Flexi hours for employees working at corporate office, Mumbai Office.

3.2.2. Employees can choose to come between 9:00:00 AM and 9:30:00 AM, provided they meet the minimum specified number of 8.5 hours for the day including Lunch Break.

Policy: Attendance and Leave Policy (Version V.02, effective 2025-01-01)
Policy ID: attendance-leave-policy
Section: 3 Attendance > 3.3 Weekly off as per shift schedule
Topic: 3.3.1 One full day consisting a period of 24 hours, after 6 days of work in a week.
3.3.1. One full day consisting a period of 24 hours, after 6 days of work in a week.

3.3.2. This is applicable to all cadre/categories of employees working in Depot, Factory and Field staff.

3.3.3. Monthly shift schedule will be communicated to the employees by their reporting manager as applicable.

3.3.4. Management at its discretion may fix different weekly off and or different shifts to different category of employees as per business need. Any such change will be notified in advance.

Policy: Attendance and Leave Policy (Version V.02, effective 2025-01-01)
Policy ID: attendance-leave-policy
Section: 3 Attendance > 3.4 Grace Period
Topic: 3.4.1 Employees will be allowed to avail a grace period of NOT more than 30 minutes once in an attendance month.
3.4.1. Employees will be allowed to avail a grace period of NOT more than 30 minutes once in an attendance month.

3.4.2. Half day leave will be auto deducted from leave balance (CL/SL/PL) for any period exceeding the permitted limit.

Policy ID: attendance-leave-policy

Topic: 3.5.1 Staggered hours of 30 minutes between 1:00:00 PM and 2:30:00 PM.
3.5.1. Staggered hours of 30 minutes between 1:00:00 PM and 2:30:00 PM.

Policy: Attendance and Leave Policy (Version V.02, effective 2025-01-01)
Policy ID: attendance-leave-policy
Section: 3 Attendance > 3.6 Permissions
Topic: 3.6.1 Employees can avail two hours permission (for early check-out or late check- in).
3.6.1. Employees can avail two hours permission (for early check-out or late check- in).

3.6.2. Late Check-in cannot be more than two occasion in a month.

3.6.3. Late Check-out cannot be more than two occasions in a month.

3.6.4. Prior approval is mandatory from reporting manager with intimation to HR Department.

3.6.5. Employees shall apply for Permission in HRMS and avail the same during working hours.

3.6.6. Half day leave will be auto deducted from leave balance (CL/PL) for any period exceeding the permitted limit.

Policy: Attendance and Leave Policy (Version V.02, effective 2025-01-01)
Policy ID: attendance-leave-policy
Section: 3 Attendance > 3.7 On-Duty and Work-From-Home
Topic: 3.7.1 Activities that require visits to Plants, Client's locations, Government Offices, Financial Institutions and Consultants' Offices are considered as 'On-Duty'.
3.7.1. Activities that require visits to Plants, Client's locations, Government Offices, Financial Institutions and Consultants' Offices are considered as 'On-Duty'.

3.7.2. Employees shall take prior approval from the reporting manager and upon approval shall applied in HRMS.

3.7.3. All such movements shall be registered in the biometrics.

3.7.4. On-Duty shall NOT be applied/ utilized for late-coming or permissions.

3.7.5. Work-From-Home option is not allowed as a practice. However for extraordinary cases/critical situations /business demands, Director/Management may approve the same on a case-case basis and at their sole discretion.

3.7.6. Employees permitted to work from home shall be paid 50% of their salary for the period they worked from home.

Policy: Attendance and Leave Policy (Version V.02, effective 2025-01-01)
Policy ID: attendance-leave-policy
Section: 3 Attendance > 3.8 Deputation
Topic: 3.8.1 Employees who are on deputation at any of the business units, office or a factory shall adhere to the work timings and holidays being followed at the location for the period of their deputation.
3.8.1. Employees who are on deputation at any of the business units, office or a factory shall adhere to the work timings and holidays being followed at the location for the period of their deputation.

Policy: Attendance and Leave Policy (Version V.02, effective 2025-01-01)
Policy ID: attendance-leave-policy
Section: 3 Attendance > 3.9 Recording attendance
Topic: 3.9.1 Payroll processing period i.e. 26 of current month to 25 of succeeding month will be considered as attendance month for all purposes.
3.9.1. Payroll processing period i.e. 26 of current month to 25 of succeeding month will be considered as attendance month for all purposes.

3.9.2. It is mandatory for every employee to record attendance only through Bio- metric System which is installed in every work location or through ESS application.

3.9.3. Single swipe or no swipe in the attendance on any day will be considered as 'Absent for Full day' and the concerned employee shall regularize the same in HRMS immediately.

3.9.4. Employees are advised to check their attendance in the Attendance Report (ESS in HRMS) on daily basis and regularize the same in case of missing swipes with proper justification.

3.9.5. Regularization of the attendance should be done before closure of the attendance month i.e. 25 of every month. If not done, it will be treated as missing punch.

3.9.6. Employees are advised to adhere to the work timings as applicable to their work location.

3.9.7. Habitual late coming/early leaving, missing punch shall be treated as loss of pay and/or shall attract disciplinary action as per policy.

Policy: Attendance and Leave Policy (Version V.02, effective 2025-01-01)
Policy ID: attendance-leave-policy
Section: 4 Leaves > 4.3 Classification of leaves
Topic: 4.3.1 Earned Leave (EL)
4.3.1. Earned Leave (EL)

4.3.1.1. Field Employees

a) All confirmed field employees are eligible for 23 days of EL per completed year of service.

b) Employees have to avail a minimum of 3 days leave in continuation to apply for EL and maximum 3 times in a calendar year.

c) ELs can be accumulated and carried forward to next year up to a maximum of 90 days.

d) Leave encashment will be done in January every year as given below. i. Upto Senior Manager Level: All ELs above the maximum accumulation limit will be encashed. ii. AGM & above Level: Maximum 8 ELs are encashed, balance ELs shall be used or will be lapsed.

4.3.1.2. Non-field employees

a) All confirmed non-field employees are eligible for 15 days of EL for one completed year of service.

b) Employees have to avail a minimum of 3 days leave in continuation to apply for EL.

c) ELs can be accumulated and carried forward to next year up to a maximum of 30 days and any un-availed ELs beyond the maximum limit will be lapsed and will not be considered for any leave encashment or compensation in-lieu of.

d) Leave encashment of un-availed ELs is allowed up to a maximum of 8 days only after completion of one year of service in the organization.

e) Accumulated EL leave balance can also be encashed upon separation.

Policy: Attendance and Leave Policy (Version V.02, effective 2025-01-01)
Policy ID: attendance-leave-policy
Section: 4 Leaves > 4.3 Classification of leaves
Topic: 4.3.2 Casual Leave (CL)
4.3.2. Casual Leave (CL)

4.3.2.1. Field Employees

a) Employees who are on probation or hired as trainees will be eligible for 2 days of CL.

b) All confirmed field employees are eligible for 8 days of CL per annum.

4.3.2.2. Non-Field Employees

a) Employees who are on probation or hired as trainees will be eligible for 3 days of CLs.

b) All confirmed non-field employees are eligible for 10 days of CLs per annum.

4.3.2.3. Availing Casual Leave

a) Employees can avail a maximum of 2 days CL in continuation.

b) Any un-availed CLs shall lapse on completion of calendar year and a fresh quota of CL shall be credited to the employee's leave account.

c) Un-availed CLs shall not be considered for encashment.

Policy: Attendance and Leave Policy (Version V.02, effective 2025-01-01)
Policy ID: attendance-leave-policy
Section: 4 Leaves > 4.3 Classification of leaves
Topic: 4.3.3 Sick Leave (SL)
4.3.3. Sick Leave (SL)

4.3.3.1. Field Employees

a) Employees who are on probation or hired as trainees will be eligible for 2 days of SL.

b) All confirmed field employees are eligible for 8 days of SL per annum.

4.3.3.2. Non-Field Employees: (Non-ESI Category)

a) Employees who are on probation or hired as trainees will be eligible for 3 days of SL.

b) All confirmed non-field employees are eligible for 10 days of SL per annum.

4.3.3.3. Availing Sick Leave

a) Employees can avail a maximum of 2 days of SL in continuation.

b) For availing SL beyond 2 days, employees shall be required to submit a medical certificate from a registered doctor.

c) Failure to submit the doctor's certificate shall attract loss of pay and may be subject to disciplinary action as per the policy.

d) Un-availed SLs shall lapse on completion of calendar year and a fresh quota of SL shall be credited to the employee's leave account.

e) SLs cannot be encashed.

Policy: Attendance and Leave Policy (Version V.02, effective 2025-01-01)
Policy ID: attendance-leave-policy
Section: 4 Leaves > 4.3 Classification of leaves
Topic: 4.3.4 Maternity Leave (ML)
4.3.4. Maternity Leave (ML)

4.3.4.1. Eligibility

a) Female employees who have worked continuously for a period of 80 days with the company in the past twelve months immediately preceding the date of expected delivery are eligible for paid maternity leave as per Maternity Benefits Act 2017.

4.3.4.2. Availing Maternity Leave

a) Eligible employees can avail of paid Maternity leave for a continuous period of 26 weeks, of which 8 weeks can be availed for the pre-natal period.

b) Any other maternity conditions other than normal pre-natal / post- natal conditions should be based on doctor's certificate and discussed with HR / Manager for sanctioning appropriate number of days leave and as permitted by law.

c) Employees must keep their reporting managers well informed of their ML to allow them to plan for continuity of work.

d) ML must be applied through ESS portal by the employee.

e) Any approved extension of ML must be updated by the reporting manager on behalf of the employee in case there is no access to the ESS portal / Official mail to the employee to avoid any loss of pay.

Policy: Attendance and Leave Policy (Version V.02, effective 2025-01-01)
Policy ID: attendance-leave-policy
Section: 4 Leaves > 4.3 Classification of leaves
Topic: 4.3.5 Paternity Leave
4.3.5. Paternity Leave

4.3.5.1. Eligibility

a) Male employees who have worked continuously for a period of 1 year with the company are eligible for Paternity leave.

4.3.5.2. Availing Paternity Leave

a) Eligible employees can avail of paid Paternity leave for a continuous of 3 days, which are inclusive of any rest days, weekends, off days, shutdown days and public holidays etc.

b) Employees must keep their reporting manager informed of their Paternity Leave in order to allow them to plan for continuity of work.

c) Paternity leave has to be regularized through ESS portal / Official mail at the earliest opportunity by the employee, which otherwise might attract loss of pay.

Policy: Attendance and Leave Policy (Version V.02, effective 2025-01-01)
Policy ID: attendance-leave-policy
Section: 4 Leaves > 4.3 Classification of leaves
Topic: 4.3.6 Marriage Leave
4.3.6. Marriage Leave

4.3.6.1. Eligibility

a) Employees who have completed minimum 1 year of service in the company are eligible for Marriage Leave.

b) This leave is given only once to employees even if they have multiple tenures with the Company.

4.3.6.2. Availing Marriage Leave

a) Employee will be entitled for 7 days of marriage leave including Sundays/holidays.

b) Employee has to submit the wedding card to the reporting manager and the HR and shall inform about the leave to the reporting manager at least 1 week in advance in order to allow them to plan for continuity of work.

c) Marriage leave has to be regularized through ESS portal / Official mail at the earliest opportunity by the employee, which otherwise might attract loss of pay.

Policy: Attendance and Leave Policy (Version V.02, effective 2025-01-01)
Policy ID: attendance-leave-policy
Section: 4 Leaves > 4.3 Classification of leaves
Topic: 4.3.7 ESI Leave
4.3.7. ESI Leave

4.3.7.1. Eligibility

a) ESI Leave is applicable for the employees who are covered under the ESI Scheme.

4.3.7.2. Availing ESI Leave

a) When the employee avails medical services from any ESI Dispensaries/ Hospitals on sickness grounds, he/she shall submit Sickness leave certificate issued by the concerned ESI Doctors to Location HR/Corporate HR.

b) When the employee resumes duties after recovering from sickness, he/she shall submit Sickness leave final certificate (fitness certificate) issued by the concerned ESI Doctors, to Location HR/Corporate HR.

c) Payment of wages during ESI Leave will be as per the provisions of the ESI Act. The ESI will process your payment as per the ESI leave period by approaching respective ESI branch office with the Sickness certificates.

Policy: Attendance and Leave Policy (Version V.02, effective 2025-01-01)
Policy ID: attendance-leave-policy
Section: 4 Leaves > 4.3 Classification of leaves
Topic: 4.3.8 Privileged Leave (For Roorkee Plant only)
4.3.8. Privileged Leave (For Roorkee Plant only)

4.3.8.1. Eligibility

a) Employees working at Roorkee plant are eligible for Privileged leave only.

b) They are NOT entitled to Casual Leaves, Sick Leaves & Earned Leaves.

c) They will be eligible for Marriage, Maternity and Paternity Leaves as per the policy.

4.3.8.2. Availing Privileged Leave

a) PL cannot be taken for more than the allowed limit. Exigencies will be considered on a case to case basis and upon necessary approvals from HOD and Head HR.

b) There is no accumulation and carry forward of Privileged Leave, Eligible balance PLs will be encashed along with January month Salary.

c) Employees must keep their reporting manager informed of their Privileged leave in order to allow them to plan for continuity of work.

Policy: Attendance and Leave Policy (Version V.02, effective 2025-01-01)
Policy ID: attendance-leave-policy
Section: 4 Leaves > 4.5 Compensatory Off (Comp Off)
Topic: 4.5.1 Eligibility
4.5.1. Eligibility

4.5.1.1. All the employees up to the grade of Assistant Manager, trainees and probationers are eligible to avail the Comp Off.

4.5.1.2. Extra hours consideration and Comp Off that can be claimed is as follows

4.5.2. Availing Comp Off

4.5.2.1. Employees who have come for work on Sundays and holidays can avail Comp Off within 60 days from the date of work.

4.5.2.2. Un-availed Comp Off will automatically lapse after 60 days

4.5.2.3. On approval of HOD, employees can avail the number of Compensatory Offs to their credit.

4.5.2.4. Employees claiming Over Time cannot apply for Comp Offs.

Policy: Attendance and Leave Policy (Version V.02, effective 2025-01-01)
Policy ID: attendance-leave-policy
Section: 4 Leaves > 4.6 Intervening holidays
Topic: 4.6.1 For the leaves that are taken immediately succeeding or preceding a weekly off, the weekly offs will not be considered as leave.
4.6.1. For the leaves that are taken immediately succeeding or preceding a weekly off, the weekly offs will not be considered as leave.

4.6.2. Any weekly offs or declared holidays which fall in between any leaves applied by an employee will be considered as leave days.

Policy: Attendance and Leave Policy (Version V.02, effective 2025-01-01)
Policy ID: attendance-leave-policy
Section: 4 Leaves > 4.7 Loss of pay / leave without pay
Topic: 4.7.1 The following actions may result in loss of pay and shall be dealt under disciplinary action policy as deemed fit.
4.7.1. The following actions may result in loss of pay and shall be dealt under disciplinary action policy as deemed fit.

4.7.1.1. Taking leave without having sufficient leave credit/balance

4.7.1.2. Taking leave without approval

4.7.1.3. Extending leave without approval

4.7.1.4. Leaves not applied / not updated in the ESS Portal

4.7.1.5. Taking sudden leaves without any valid reasons at the time of important meeting, joint field work, closing days, or any other business exigencies.

4.7.1.6. Failure to submit required medical certificates or any other document as needed by the company

4.7.1.7. Disciplinary actions taken in lieu of habituated late coming and missing punch

Policy: Attendance and Leave Policy (Version V.02, effective 2025-01-01)
Policy ID: attendance-leave-policy
Section: 4 Leaves > 4.8 Leaves during notice period
Topic: 4.8.1 All kinds of leaves shall stand cancelled from the date of notice of resignation.
4.8.1. All kinds of leaves shall stand cancelled from the date of notice of resignation.

4.8.2. In case an employee is required to take leave for some unavoidable reasons then employee shall have to complete the duration of notice by serving an equivalent number of days he/she was on leave or shall have to forego the pay equivalent to number of days on leave.

4.8.3. However the discretion of allowing either of the two rests with HOD and HR.

4.8.4. In case any employee separates from the Company during the calendar year for whatsoever reason, the employee can encash their accumulated ELs up to the last working day on pro-rata basis.

4.8.5. If the availed leaves (any) are in excess of the pro-rata entitlement, it will be subject to adjustment against leave encashment and/or deduction from the Full & Final Settlement.

Policy: Attendance and Leave Policy (Version V.02, effective 2025-01-01)
Policy ID: attendance-leave-policy
Section: 4 Leaves > 4.9 Procedure for applying leave
Topic: 4.9.1 Employees are NOT allowed to merge any two or more types of leaves continuously.
4.9.1. Employees are NOT allowed to merge any two or more types of leaves continuously.

4.9.2. All leaves should be informed to the reporting manager at least 2 days in advance (3 weeks in case of EL) to ensure seamless functioning of the operations.

4.9.3. Sick leave / medical emergencies have to be intimated to the reporting manager / HR either through email / text / call.

4.9.4. All leaves should be appropriately applied and regularized through Imacx/ ESS portal before closing of the attendance month.

4.9.5. Every employee shall mention the contact number and address during the leave period, while applying for leave in HRMS.

4.9.6. In case any employee, after proceeding on sanctioned leave, intends to extend such sanctioned leave, should communicate to the Immediate Reporting Manager and HR well before the lapse of such sanctioned leave.

4.9.7. Grant of leaves is at the discretion of the reporting manager or HR, as the case may be, and in line with the ground reality of any important assignments or business exigencies that cannot be compromised.

Policy: Attendance and Leave Policy (Version V.02, effective 2025-01-01)
Policy ID: attendance-leave-policy
Section: 4 Leaves > 4.10 Entitlement of Leaves for Transferred Employee
Topic: 4.10.1 Employees transferred from Offices/R&D to Factory/Field:
4.10.1. Employees transferred from Offices/R&D to Factory/Field:

4.10.1.1. Available ELs in the Leave Account & Pro-rata ELs for the current year till the date of transfer will be converted into Privileged Leaves.

4.10.1.2. Privileged Leaves of the current year will be added on pro-rata basis to the Leave Account of the respective employee.

4.10.1.3. Available CL and SL in Leave Accounts of the respective employees will be lapsed automatically for Roorkee.

4.10.2. For the Employees transferred from Factory Unit/Field to Offices/R&D:

4.10.2.1. Available Privileged Leaves in leave accounts of the respective employees will be converted into ELs on pro-rata basis from the date of transfer.

4.10.2.2. Additionally, CLs and SLs will be credited in leave accounts of the respective employees on pro-rata basis from the date of transfer to the Unit.

Policy: Attendance and Leave Policy (Version V.02, effective 2025-01-01)
Policy ID: attendance-leave-policy
Section: 5 Holidays
5.1. National and Festival holiday list will be finalized by HR and HOD as per the respective state law and will be communicated to all employees in the month of December every year.

Policy: Attendance and Leave Policy (Version V.02, effective 2025-01-01)
Policy ID: attendance-leave-policy
Section: 6 General conditions
6.1 Sanction of any type of Leave is not a matter of right.

6.2 Mere submission of leave application will not be deemed that the leave is sanctioned.

6.3 Immediate Reporting Manager/HOD may refuse or reduce or post-pone the applied leave for any employee, due to business exigencies.

6.4 Further, the Immediate Reporting Manager/HOD may recall any employee from leave, in case of work exigency and refusal to be back from leave will be viewed seriously.

6.5 No leave or extension of leave shall be deemed to have been granted unless the approvals to that effect are communicated to the concerned employee.

6.6 Monthly Gross Salary will be considered for deduction proportionately, in case of Loss of Pay.

6.7 Management may relax any conditions pertaining to any of the above leaves, based on merits and circumstances of the case.

6.8 It is the responsibility of an employee to keep abreast with the changes in the prevalent policies, which are available in HRMS.

6.9 ESI and Maternity Leave benefits will be revised and made applicable to the concerned employees, as and when there is/are amendment/s made in the relevant Acts to that effect by the Government. The Management reserves its right to amend the policy as per the business need and if appropriate at any time. Such amended policy will be communicated to the employees through the appropriate channel. : 1-January-2025 Version : V.02
